utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Registrar, can you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you and good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-03-67-T, the Prosecutor versus Vojislav Seselj.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Registrar. Today is Wednesday. I would like to greet Mr. Seselj, the entire team of the Prosecution, Ms. Biersay, Ms. Dahl and Mr. Mundis, as well as their associates, and all people assisting us. We shall now move into private session -- closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Do we have the original in the case file also, at least until the completion of the first-instance case, first-instance proceedings?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] One moment. Yes, for the time being, the original is in the other case, and the Trial Chamber will see which is the best way forward. We cannot answer your question right now. We are now in open session. Mr. Seselj, we will not reconvene until August, since we're going to have our summer recess. I asked the Registry to find a date around the 18th of August, since we're supposed to resume on the first Monday of the third week of August, so we're bound to reconvene on Tuesday of that week. We're not going to have any witness, so we're going to take stock then of any administrative issues that may be still pending then. But before we adjourn, do you have anything to say in relation to what you said yesterday? And I'll put the same question then later to the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yesterday, I exhaustively presented my views to you, and I do hope that I will be around, around the 18th of August.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Mundis or Ms. Dahl, do you have anything to say?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The Prosecution has nothing further for today, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Well, I can't wait to see you again, which will probably be around the 18th of August.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.26 p.m.,
